progression_tree.description: Demolitionists are experts in explosives—breaching defenses, collapsing fortifications, and controlling the battlefield through calculated detonations.

You can place a breaching charge on a door, wall, or barrier you can touch as an action. The charge detonates after 1 round, dealing force damage in a 10-foot radius (Dex save for half) and automatically opening/breaking mundane barriers of up to reinforced door strength. You can create a number of charges per long rest equal to your proficiency bonus.

effects.notes: Place charge; detonate after 1 round; open/breach barriers

progression_tree.description: Your explosions spare allies. When you cause an explosion from a charge or grenade, you can choose a number of creatures up to your Dexterity modifier to automatically succeed on the saving throw and take no damage on a success.

effects.notes: Protect allies in blast up to DEX mod

progression_tree.description: You can deploy proximity mines covering a 15-foot cone. The first time a creature enters the area on a turn, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take explosive damage and have its speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. The field persists for 1 minute or until dismissed.

effects.notes: Cone of proximity mines; damage + slow on trigger

progression_tree.description: When you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack, you can trigger a delayed micro-charge on a surface within 5 feet of the target to detonate, forcing the target and each creature within 5 feet to make a Dexterity saving throw or take explosive damage. You can use this feature a number of times per short rest equal to your proficiency bonus.

effects.notes: Detonate secondary blast near the hit target

progression_tree.description: For 1 minute (once per long rest), your explosives are hyper-efficient. Your explosive effects deal maximum damage on a failed save and half of maximum on a successful save; structures have vulnerability to your explosive damage.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assumes a powerful stance, feet shoulder-width apart, with lightsaber at the ready
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Surrounded by an aura of blue and purple energy, signifying the user's connection to the Force

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A Jedi Master stands proudly, holding their lightsaber aloft in a moment of triumph over the dark side
contextual_modifiers: With stormy weather in the background

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: A skilled engineer who uses explosives to demolish enemy fortifications, creating breaches in defensive lines and weakening enemy positions.
